verdict.rationale: MX documents retrieving account and transaction data through its Platform API, with stated history depth: 90 days via Account Aggregation and up to 24 months via Extended Transaction History. It also documents automatic re-aggregation roughly every 24 hours and general-purpose webhooks, but nothing shows paginated transaction endpoints or an incremental change-only sync pattern. missing for 10: documented pagination of transaction list endpoints, a delta/cursor or updated-since sync mechanism for fetching only changed transactions, transaction-specific webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
